propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit ticket by git-blame of pre-fix state, resolving commit via rebar-ticket: trailer, but only when >50% of blamed lines point to a single commit.
The --caused-by <id> parameter allows explicit override/augmentation of auto-derived caused_by at close time.
The auto-link must bypass the closed-source guard (source_status == 'closed' rejection) by writing directly via _write_link_event after the bug is already closed by txn.transition_core.
The caused_by parameter must be threaded end-to-end: _parse_flags → transition_cli → transition_compute → close_ticket, and exposed in the public library facade transition().
Ambiguous cases (no file_impact, no fixing commit, no >50% dominant commit, no resolvable trailer, or multi-commit spread) return None and do not block close.
The blame-hunt advisory in user-guide.md documents when auto-derivation applies and when to use --caused-by explicitly.
